facts.fact: 晨间安详：他这辈子从没这么平静过。
facts.anchor: I had never felt this at peace in my entire life.

facts.fact: 她的早晨挑衅：你把我弄疼了，至少该把我舔好。
facts.anchor: Since you made me sore, the least you could do is lick me better.

facts.fact: 紧急电话：州警在州界扣下整支北方货运车队。
facts.anchor: The state troopers just pulled over and detained our entire northern freight run at the state line.

facts.fact: 关键情报核对：Lobo 冷链制药车走同一条公路、用联邦免疫 transponder。
facts.anchor: Sorsha’s cold-chain pharmaceutical trucks were on the exact same highway using those federal immunity transponders.

facts.fact: 只有 Blackwood 的车被拦——对方握有车牌与箱号。
他的观察：她一点也不意外——像早就知道。
facts.anchor: She looked like someone who had already possessed this information before my phone ever rang.

facts.fact: 他的怀疑直白成形：我妻子是不是坐在我家里的内线？
facts.anchor: Was my wife a mole sitting in my own house?

facts.fact: 她的回应：我知道怎么修。
她的条件：但你得相信我。
facts.anchor: But you're going to have to trust me, Gunnar.
I realized I didn't. I didn't trust her. Not entirely.

facts.fact: 他的承诺：我不会让任何人伤你——包括你母亲。
facts.anchor: I won't let anyone hurt you, Rosalind—including your mother.
